parameters.value: ={{ $('Validate Input').first().json.guestName }} podcast interview {{ $('Validate Input').first().json.episodeTopic }} {{ new Date().getFullYear() }}

values.content:
You are a research assistant who prepares podcast host briefings before interviews. Your job is to synthesize everything you know and have found about a guest into a tight, useful document that helps the host walk in prepared.

A good briefing:
- Gives the host a clear sense of who this person actually is (not just their title)
- Surfaces the most interesting or surprising things about their background
- Identifies angles and questions the host could explore that other podcasts probably haven't
- Flags things to avoid or handle carefully
- Includes a set of questions at different depths — some easy openers, some substantive, some that could lead somewhere unexpected

You write clearly. No filler. The host will read this 30 minutes before the interview. Make every sentence count.

Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const b = $input.first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const qSection = (label, qs, color) => `
${label}
${(qs||[]).map(q => `
${esc(q)}
`).join('')}
`; const pillList = (items, color) => (items||[]).map(i => `${esc(i)}`).join(''); const unexploredAngles = (b.unexplored_angles||[]).map(a => `
${esc(a.angle)}
${esc(a.why_interesting)}
`).join(''); const sources = (b.sources_consulted||[]).map(url => `
${esc(url.slice(0,80))}${url.length>80?'...':''}
`).join(''); const html = `
${esc(b._podcastName)} · Pre-Interview Briefing
${esc(b.guest_name)}
${esc(b.episode_topic)}${b._interviewDate ? ' · ' + b._interviewDate : ''}
TL;DR

${esc(b.tldr)}

Background

${esc(b.background_snapshot)}

Key expertise
${pillList(b.key_expertise, '#e0f2fe')}
Notable facts
${(b.notable_facts||[]).map(f => `
${esc(f)}
`).join('')}
Their known positions
${(b.known_positions||[]).map(p => `
${esc(p)}
`).join('')}
Unexplored angles
${unexploredAngles}
Questions
${qSection('Openers', b.questions?.openers, '#6b7280')} ${qSection('Substantive', b.questions?.substantive, '#2563eb')} ${qSection('Unexpected', b.questions?.unexpected, '#7c3aed')} ${qSection('Closing', b.questions?.closing, '#6b7280')}
${(b.handle_with_care||[]).length ? `
⚠ Handle with care
${(b.handle_with_care||[]).map(h => `
${esc(h)}
`).join('')}
` : ''}
What to avoid
${esc(b.what_to_avoid)}
${sources ? `
Sources
${sources}
` : ''}
Podcast Research Briefing · Generated ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
`; return [{ json: { html, guestName: b.guest_name, hostEmail: b._hostEmail, briefing: b } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'generated', guest: $json.guestName, emailed: $json.hostEmail ? true : false, briefing: $json.briefing } }}
